title: GitHub - brian-armstrong/fec: Rust crate for Forward Error Correction
excerpt: Rust crate for Forward Error Correction. Contribute to brian-armstrong/fec development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Forward error correction for SDR, space, and satellite applications.

fec implements two error-correcting codes that show up throughout software-defined radio and spacecraft links:

  • Convolutional codes with a Viterbi decoder (hard and soft decision), including the common rate-1/2 k=7, rate-1/2 k=9, rate-1/3 k=9, and rate-1/6 k=15 codes. Supports any rate from 1/2 to 1/8 and any order from k=4 to k=16. On nightly Rust, the simd feature enables a Viterbi decoder with acceleration on SSE/AVX2/AVX512.
  • Reed–Solomon codes over GF(2⁸) with error and erasure decoding, including the standard CCSDS (255,223) code in both the conventional and the on-the-wire dual-basis (Berlekamp) representations.

fec started as and draws heavy inspiration from the author's own libcorrect, a C library for forward error correction. This crate also credits Phil Karn's libfec C library for offering an original implementation of these codes, although this crate does not borrow any source or have any relationship with that library, and the name is purely coincidental.

Standard parameters (primitive polynomials, the CCSDS dual-basis transform) are derived from the published CCSDS standard (CCSDS 131.0-B, Annex D for the dual basis).

Performance

With the simd feature, fec decodes faster than libfec on every code. Measured through libfec's own test programs with only the codec library swapped, on a Zen4 laptop (Ryzen 7840HS). Higher is better.

code fec (64-bit) libfec (32-bit) libfec (64-bit)
conv, rate 1/2, k=7 158 Mbps 148 Mbps1 17 Mbps
conv, rate 1/2, k=9 66 Mbps 65 Mbps1 3 Mbps
conv, rate 1/3, k=9 61 Mbps 23 Mbps1 2 Mbps
conv, rate 1/6, k=15 1187 Kbps 415 Kbps1 40 Kbps
RS (255,223), general 568 Mbps 123 Mbps 157 Mbps
RS (255,223), CCSDS 568 Mbps 198 Mbps 223 Mbps
RS (255,223), general, 2 err 445 Mbps 108 Mbps 150 Mbps
RS (255,223), CCSDS, 2 err 443 Mbps 165 Mbps 207 Mbps

Convolutional throughput is decoded payload bits per second. The Reed-Solomon rows decode a (255,223) block, first with no errors (syndromes only) and then with two symbol errors. Reed-Solomon uses no SIMD in either library, so its 32-bit and 64-bit rows differ only by pointer width.

See shim/BENCH.md for the full tables, the bit error rate comparison, the 32-bit numbers, and how to reproduce them.

Quick start

Convolutional (Viterbi)

use fec::{ConvEncoder, ConvDecoder};

// Rate-1/2, order-7 NASA code.
let polys = [0o161, 0o127];
let mut enc = ConvEncoder::new(2, 7, &polys);
let mut dec = ConvDecoder::new(2, 7, &polys);

let msg = b"hello, error correction";
let mut encoded = vec![0u8; enc.encode_len(msg.len())];
let num_bits = enc.encode(msg, &mut encoded).unwrap();

// ... encoded is corrupted in transit ...

let mut recovered = vec![0u8; msg.len()];
dec.decode_hard(&encoded, num_bits, &mut recovered).unwrap();

decode_soft takes 8-bit soft symbols instead, which corrects more errors when the demodulator can report its confidence.

Reed–Solomon

use fec::{RsEncoder, RsDecoder};

// Standard CCSDS (255,223) code.
let mut enc = RsEncoder::new_ccsds();
let mut dec = RsDecoder::new_ccsds();

let msg: Vec<u8> = (0..223).collect();
let mut block = vec![0u8; 255];
enc.encode(&msg, &mut block).unwrap();

// ... block is corrupted in transit ...

let mut recovered = vec![0u8; 223];
let corrected = dec.decode(&block, &mut recovered).unwrap();
println!("corrected {corrected} symbol error(s)");

For real spacecraft telemetry (dual-basis symbols on the wire), use encode_ccsds_dual / decode_ccsds_dual.

Compatibility

The codes are bit-compatible with libfec (Phil Karn, KA9Q), so fec can decode data Karn's library produced and vice versa. A companion shim crate, fec-shim, exposes fec under libfec's C ABI (init_rs_char, create_viterbi27, encode_rs_ccsds, etc) as a drop-in for existing C codebases.

Roadmap

  • More widths for the Reed-Solomon encoder/decoder (narrower than GF(2⁸) and as wide as GF(2¹⁶))
  • Hard-decision erasures in the convolutional (Viterbi) decoder
  • Punctured codes for the convolutional encoder and decoder

License

BSD-3-Clause.

Footnotes

  1. libfec's SIMD kernels are gated behind #ifdef __i386__, so its fastest convolutional build is the 32-bit one, running Karn's SSE2 assembly. A 64-bit libfec build has no SIMD path at all. fec's SIMD works on both. ↩ ↩2 ↩3 ↩4

content_html_zh:
适用于 SDR、太空和卫星应用的前向纠错。

fec 实现了两个纠错码，它们出现在软件定义的无线电和航天器链路中：

  • 带维特比解码器的卷积码（硬判决和软判决），包括常见的rate-1/2 k=7、rate-1/2 k=9、rate-1/3 k=9和rate-1/6 k=15码。 支持从 1/2 到 1/8 的任意速率以及从 k=4 到 k=16 的任意阶数。 在 nightly Rust 上，simd 功能启用了 Viterbi 解码器，并在 SSE/AVX2/AVX512 上进行加速。
  • 基于 GF(2⁸) 的 Reed-Solomon 编码，具有错误和擦除解码功能，包括传统和在线双基 (Berlekamp) 表示形式中的标准 CCSDS (255,223) 代码。

fec 最初是从作者自己的 lib Correct（一个用于前向纠错的 C 库）中汲取了大量灵感。 该板条箱还归功于 Phil Karn 的 libfec C 库提供了这些代码的原始实现，尽管该板条箱没有借用任何源代码或与该库有任何关系，并且名称纯属巧合。

标准参数（原多项式、CCSDS 双基变换）源自已发布的 CCSDS 标准（CCSDS 131.0-B，双基附录 D）。

表现

借助 simd 功能，fec 在每个代码上的解码速度都比 libfec 更快。 在 Zen4 笔记本电脑 (Ryzen 7840HS) 上通过 libfec 自己的测试程序进行测量，仅交换编解码器库。 越高越好。

code fec（64 位） libfec（32 位） libfec（64 位）
转换，速率 1/2，k=7 158 Mbps 148 Mbps1 17 Mbps
转换，速率 1/2，k=9 66 Mbps 65 Mbps1 3 Mbps
转换，速率 1/3，k=9 61 Mbps 23 Mbps1 2 Mbps
转化率，速率 1/6，k=15 1187 Kbps 415 Kbps1 40 Kbps
RS (255,223)，一般 568 Mbps 123 Mbps 157 Mbps
RS (255,223)、CCSDS 568 Mbps 198 Mbps 223 Mbps

卷积吞吐量是每秒解码的有效负载位数。 Reed-Solomon 行对 (255,223) 块进行解码，首先没有错误（仅综合症），然后有两个符号错误。 Reed-Solomon 在这两个库中均不使用 SIMD，因此其 32 位和 64 位行仅在指针宽度上有所不同。

请参阅 shim/BENCH.md 了解完整表格、误码率比较、32 位数字以及如何重现它们。

快速启动

卷积（维特比）

use fec::{ConvEncoder, ConvDecoder};

// Rate-1/2, order-7 NASA code.
let polys = [0o161, 0o127];
let mut enc = ConvEncoder::new(2, 7, &polys);
let mut dec = ConvDecoder::new(2, 7, &polys);

let msg = b"hello, error correction";
let mut encoded = vec![0u8; enc.encode_len(msg.len())];
let num_bits = enc.encode(msg, &mut encoded).unwrap();

// ... encoded is corrupted in transit ...

let mut recovered = vec![0u8; msg.len()];
dec.decode_hard(&encoded, num_bits, &mut recovered).unwrap();

decode_soft 采用 8 位软符号，当解调器可以报告其置信度时，它会纠正更多错误。

里德-所罗门

use fec::{RsEncoder, RsDecoder};

// Standard CCSDS (255,223) code.
let mut enc = RsEncoder::new_ccsds();
let mut dec = RsDecoder::new_ccsds();

let msg: Vec<u8> = (0..223).collect();
let mut block = vec![0u8; 255];
enc.encode(&msg, &mut block).unwrap();

// ... block is corrupted in transit ...

let mut recovered = vec![0u8; 223];
let corrected = dec.decode(&block, &mut recovered).unwrap();
println!("corrected {corrected} symbol error(s)");

对于真实的航天器遥测（线路上的双基符号），请使用encode_ccsds_dual /decode_ccsds_dual。

兼容性

这些代码与 libfec（Phil Karn、KA9Q）位兼容，因此 fec 可以解码 Karn 库生成的数据，反之亦然。 配套的垫片箱 fec-shim 在 libfec 的 C ABI（init_rs_char、create_viterbi27、encode_rs_ccsds 等）下公开 fec，作为现有 C 代码库的插件。

路线图

  • Reed-Solomon 编码器/解码器的更多宽度（比 GF(2⁸) 更窄，与 GF(21⁶) 一样宽）
  • 卷积（维特比）解码器中的硬决策擦除
  • 卷积编码器和解码器的删截码
